branches.label: 估算页数时长
branches.query: Parse Fountain screenplay scenes, separate dialogue and action, estimate formatted page count and adjusted running time against a 110-minute feature target. Identify acts outside the target.

branches.label: 编排自动检查
branches.query: Create a GitHub Actions YAML workflow and Python entry point for a Fountain screenplay repository. Trigger on main pushes, report page count and runtime drift, and open a length-warning issue when the deviation exceeds 15 minutes.
